stories.title: Extorsión, posible móvil de ataque a Elvis Guerra, diseñadora muxe de Oaxaca; Sheinbaum garantiza que cuenta con protección

en.title: Extortion seen as possible motive in attack on Elvis Guerra, Oaxaca muxe designer; Sheinbaum guarantees protection
en.summary: An attack on Oaxacan designer Elvis Guerra may have been motivated by extortion. The government has pledged to provide protection.

stories.title: México envejece: personas de 60 años y más llegarán al 34.2% en 2070

en.title: Mexico ages: people aged 60 and older will reach 34.2% by 2070
en.summary: Mexico's population is aging significantly, with elderly citizens projected to comprise over one-third by 2070. Common pension planning mistakes include insufficient savings and delayed preparation.

stories.title: Estas son las marchas y movilizaciones previstas para este 21 de septiembre; prevé afectaciones viales

en.title: These are the marches and mobilizations planned for September 21; road disruptions expected
en.summary: Multiple demonstrations are scheduled for September 21st. Concentrations began starting at 9:30 AM and traffic disruptions are anticipated.

stories.title: Liberan a tres personas privadas de la libertad en Puerto Peñasco, Sonora; detienen a siete y aseguran arsenal tras operativo

en.title: Three kidnapping victims freed in Puerto Peñasco, Sonora; seven detained and arsenal seized in operation
en.summary: Authorities in Puerto Peñasco rescued three kidnapped persons and arrested seven suspects. They recovered over 40 long guns, three machine guns, thousands of rounds, explosives, drugs, and stolen vehicles.

stories.title: Sheinbaum no descarta apoyo a otra candidatura a la ONU tras retiro de Bachelet; “me parece bien que haya competido”, expresa

en.title: Sheinbaum does not rule out support for another candidacy at the UN after Bachelet's withdrawal; "I think it's good that she competed", she expresses
en.summary: Mexico's president stated she would consider backing an alternative candidate for a UN position following the withdrawal of a previous contender, expressing approval of the previous candidacy effort.

stories.title: Bolsa mexicana inicia la semana con pérdidas y toca nuevo mínimo anual

en.title: Mexican stock exchange begins the week with losses and touches new annual low
en.summary: Local market indices declined for a second consecutive session, with investors focused on an upcoming meeting between Trump and Xi Jinping and a Banxico announcement.

stories.title: Tormenta tropical Polo causará lluvias intensas mientras avanza cerca de Guerrero y Colima

en.title: Tropical storm Polo will cause intense rainfall as it advances near Guerrero and Colima
en.summary: The storm will produce waves of 2 to 3 meters high on Guerrero and Michoacán coasts, and 1.5 to 2.5 meters on Oaxaca's coast.

stories.title: Sheinbaum anuncia que ya no se podrán usar celulares en el salón y el recreo: ¿Cuándo arranca la medida?

en.title: Sheinbaum announces that cell phones can no longer be used in classrooms and recess: When does the measure begin?
en.summary: Starting November 3, mobile phones and tablets will be prohibited during classes and recess periods, with exceptions allowed for emergencies and educational purposes.

stories.title: Esta es la historia de Baltazar, el cocodrilo poblano; fue abandonado en una laguna

en.title: This is the story of Baltazar, the Puebla crocodile; he was abandoned in a lagoon
en.summary: A young marsh crocodile less than a year old, measuring approximately 75 centimeters, was abandoned in a lagoon in Puebla.

stories.title: CNN, MS NOW y Politico demandan a la Casa Blanca por veto; cadenas se solidarizan y no cubrirán a Donald Trump

en.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue the White House over veto; networks show solidarity and will not cover Donald Trump
en.summary: Multiple news networks filed legal action against the U.S. President's administration, citing concerns about threats to press freedom.

stories.title: CNN, MS NOW y Politico presentarán una demanda por el veto de la Casa Blanca

en.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico will file a lawsuit over the White House veto
en.summary: Three news outlets announced plans to sue the Trump administration to protect their constitutional rights under the First Amendment.

stories.title: Depresión se convierte en tormenta Polo al sur de Colima y Michoacán; advierten una rápida intensificación

en.title: Depression becomes storm Polo south of Colima and Michoacán; rapid intensification warned
en.summary: A weather system in southern Mexico is strengthening and expected to intensify rapidly in the coming period.

stories.title: UNAM abre otra oportunidad para estudiar una licenciatura a distancia; esto debes saber

en.title: UNAM opens another opportunity to study a bachelor's degree at a distance; here's what you should know
en.summary: The UNAM is preparing a new enrollment period for those seeking to pursue a bachelor's degree through a flexible remote learning model.

stories.title: Contrataste un seguro médico para estar cubierto, pero hay gastos que podrías pagar tú

en.title: You hired medical insurance to be covered, but there are expenses you could pay yourself
en.summary: Health insurance policies contain coverage limits and conditions that consumers should understand before purchasing major medical expense insurance to avoid unexpected out-of-pocket costs.
